verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a payments platform, but the evidence never shows Tilled offering a self-hostable deployment. The white-label custom-domain feature only maps Tilled-hosted API, console and onboarding experiences onto a partner's domain "while staying within the Tilled login experience." That is an adjacent branding capability, not self-hosting, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
